cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el total vendido por canal de pedido en marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT so.order_type, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS total FROM sales_order so JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = so.id WHERE so.status = 'Closed' AND so.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND so.ordered_at < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY so.order_type ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT so.order_type AS canal, SUM(si.total_amount) AS total_vendido FROM public.sales_invoice AS si JOIN public.sales_order AS so ON si.order_id = so.id WHERE si.issued_at >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND si.issued_at < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY so.order_type LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuántos pedidos cerrados se atendieron en cada mesa durante marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT dt.number AS mesa, COUNT(DISTINCT so.id) AS pedidos FROM sales_order so JOIN order_table ot ON ot.order_id = so.id JOIN dining_table dt ON dt.id = ot.table_id WHERE so.status = 'Closed' AND so.order_type = 'Mesa' AND so.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND so.ordered_at < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY dt.id, dt.number ORDER BY dt.number LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el total de facturas de compra activas en marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pi.total_amount), 0) AS total FROM purchase_invoice pi WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND pi.issued_at < DATE '2026-04-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_facturas FROM public.purchase_invoice AS pi WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND pi.issued_at < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se compró a cada proveedor en marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT s.business_name AS proveedor, SUM(pi.total_amount) AS total FROM purchase_invoice pi JOIN supplier s ON s.id = pi.supplier_id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND pi.issued_at < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY s.id, s.business_name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT s.business_name AS proveedor, SUM(pi.total_amount) AS total_compras FROM public.purchase_invoice AS pi JOIN public.supplier AS s ON pi.supplier_id = s.id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND pi.issued_at < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.business_name LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se pagó por cada medio de pago a proveedores en marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT pt.name AS medio, SUM(pp.amount) AS total FROM purchase_payment pp JOIN payment_type pt ON pt.id = pp.payment_type_id WHERE pp.paid_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND pp.paid_at < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY pt.id, pt.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT pt.name AS payment_type, COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) AS total_paid FROM public.purchase_payment AS pp JOIN public.payment_type AS pt ON pp.payment_type_id = pt.id WHERE pp.paid_at >= CAST('2026-03-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND pp.paid_at < CAST('2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY pt.name LIMIT 50

cases.expected_sql: SELECT po.status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.issued_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND po.issued_at < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY po.status ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuántas unidades recibidas hubo por producto en órdenes de compra de marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(poi.quantity_received) AS unidades FROM purchase_order po JOIN purchase_order_item poi ON poi.purchase_order_id = po.id JOIN product p ON p.id = poi.product_id WHERE po.issued_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND po.issued_at < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY unidades DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT p.name AS producto, SUM(poi.quantity_received) AS total_unidades_recibidas FROM public.purchase_order_item AS poi JOIN public.purchase_order AS po ON poi.purchase_order_id = po.id JOIN public.product AS p ON poi.product_id = p.id WHERE po.issued_at >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND po.issued_at < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Qué facturas de compra activas tienen saldo pendiente en marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT s.business_name AS proveedor, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) AS saldo_pendiente FROM purchase_invoice pi JOIN supplier s ON s.id = pi.supplier_id LEFT JOIN purchase_payment pp ON pp.purchase_invoice_id = pi.id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND pi.issued_at < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY s.id, s.business_name, pi.id, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount HAVING pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) > 0 ORDER BY saldo_pendiente DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT pi.id AS id, pi.series AS series, pi.number AS number, pi.issued_at AS issued_at, pi.total_amount AS total_amount, s.business_name AS business_name FROM public.purchase_invoice AS pi JOIN public.supplier AS s ON pi.supplier_id = s.id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND pi.issued_at < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND pi.total_amount > COALESCE((SELECT SUM(pp.amount) AS _col_0 FROM public.purchase_payment AS pp WHERE pp.purchase_invoice_id = pi.id), 0) LIMIT 50
